name: Personal legal matters
one_line: A safety-only situation for court, tribunal, agency and pre-action records held by a person in their own dispute or proceeding: filings, service papers, hearing notices, evidence indexes, counsel correspondence, sworn statements, settlements, orders and appeals. It recognizes holder-facing matter structure, writes no Legal fields, recommends no folder dimensions, and protects before any model or placement path.
design_cite: 00 names the situation among its template coverage: 'covering common organizational situations such as academic programs, university applications, recruiting processes, client engagements, research workflows, financial records, travel, legal matters, creative projects, software repositories, personal administration, and photo collections.' It then requires: 'Finance, identity, medical, and legal material should be implemented first as safety domains, meaning the system detects and protects them before any cloud or automated placement decision is allowed.' It also permits isolated surfacing: 'Rare but sensitive files such as passports, visas, and legal documents may be surfaced as protected records even when they do not meet a normal group-size threshold.'

deterministic: a PERSONAL COURT OR TRIBUNAL RECORD that satisfies the existing R2 rule family det-legal-court-filing - a caption in heading position together with case-structure labels - AND contains direct holder-role evidence in the same file, such as the holder named as a party, the document addressed or served to the holder, or the holder's completed signature block. The detector rule protects any matching filing; the added holder relation is what selects this narrower template. No labels, regexes, counts or jurisdiction values are copied here

a PARTY-FACING SUMMONS, WRIT, CLAIM, COMPLAINT, ANSWER, ORDER OR HEARING NOTICE with an official court or tribunal heading, a caption or labelled party-role block, a matter-reference slot, and a service, response, signature or recipient block tied directly to the holder. The matter reference is an observation only; the field-less Legal schema cannot store it

a NOTICE OF ELECTRONIC FILING or equivalent court-generated filing receipt in a native email record whose structured sender and subject slots, case name or reference, docket-entry description, attached-document name and recipient or service block cohere as one filing event involving the holder. The email source type and a court-looking sender domain are never enough

a REPRESENTATIVE-TO-HOLDER LETTER whose addressee block identifies the holder, whose subject or early body carries an explicit case, claim or dispute reference, and whose text states a concrete filing, instruction, request or procedural update. A law-firm name, lawyer title, privilege footer or letterhead is never enough

a SWORN MATTER STATEMENT that satisfies the existing R2 rule family det-legal-notarized-instrument through a populated notarial or attestation block AND separately carries a case, claim, agency proceeding or dispute reference tied to the holder. The R2 rule protects a broader class of instruments; the matter reference is what selects this template, and a blank jurat or notary advertisement selects nothing

a SIGNED SETTLEMENT, CONSENT ORDER OR RELEASE whose recitals identify an existing dispute, claim, proceeding or demand, whose operative provisions resolve that dispute, and whose execution block is completed. An execution block without dispute context belongs to broader Legal protection or legal.leases-agreements, not automatically to this personal-matter situation

a MATTER EVIDENCE INDEX or disclosure list in a spreadsheet or structured document whose title or header carries a caption or claim reference and whose labelled columns enumerate exhibits, filings or service records. The index can anchor a candidate matter group, but its row values never become Legal facts and never propagate to the indexed files

an ARCHIVE MANIFEST, read without unpacking, in which a caption or matter reference recurs across filing-, notice-, exhibit- and correspondence-shaped member names together with manifest-visible direct holder evidence through a party-, recipient- or signer-shaped member. The archive remains one file version; member observations do not become facts on the outer archive or vice versa

a CALENDAR record whose labelled summary carries both a hearing, conference, mediation or tribunal function and an explicit case or claim reference, with the holder present in a structured attendee, organizer or party-facing note. Calendar is a source type, not a domain, and the event's times are observations rather than Legal facts
needs_llm: an unlabelled demand, termination, complaint or response letter whose operative force is expressed only in prose. A bounded local or explicitly permitted model may distinguish a genuine dispute step from an ordinary customer complaint, negotiation draft or emotional note; it must cite the operative sentence or return unknown

a published judgment, law-school case, research download or news attachment whose court caption is byte-for-byte indistinguishable from a personal filing but has no direct holder relation. R2 may over-protect it safely; selecting this template requires local custody or purpose evidence and must remain unknown when that evidence is absent

a screenshot of a court, tribunal, regulator, mediation or lawyer portal. OCR may expose a caption, reference and status text, but a model must distinguish a holder-facing case page from a news result, public docket, training system or saved reference and must not treat the displayed status as current

a multilingual or jurisdiction-unmodelled filing whose labels are outside the injected legal-caption gazetteer. Protection stays first; a model may interpret only a compact, consent-authorized local dossier and may not invent a jurisdiction, document kind, party role or outcome

a heterogeneous evidence bundle whose lease, receipts, photographs, messages and forms may support one dispute. The model may assess candidate group coherence and outliers from manifest and file-local evidence, but it may not copy a matter reference, party, date, amount or allegation onto a sparse member

a representative's letter that names a firm and a matter but does not clearly identify whether the holder is client, opponent, witness, employee or a reader. Firm identity and legal vocabulary cannot decide the role

a shared pleading or order found in both a person's records and a law firm's exported client file. If neither party-facing custody evidence nor practice-only operational evidence is present, the personal-versus-practice template choice must abstain

a notice at the boundary with tax, insurance, association, licensing, schooling or immigration administration. The model may apply the authored collision discriminators to the same evidence item; it may not treat every appeal, hearing, penalty, deadline or statutory citation as a personal legal proceeding

a signed instrument that could be an estate-planning document, an ongoing lease or agreement, or a settlement inside an active matter. The operative function and surrounding matter evidence decide the template; signature, notary and governing-law language alone do not
never_alone: R2's det-legal-court-filing firing by itself. A published judgment or blank public court form may carry a caption and case labels; that is enough to protect, not enough to assert that the holder is personally involved

a court, tribunal, regulator, law firm, lawyer, mediator, bailiff or legal-aid organization name, logo, email domain, letterhead, footer or producer metadata. The same organization may be issuer, counsel, opponent, cited authority, publisher, employer or template producer

a person or organization name next to plaintiff, defendant, claimant, respondent, applicant, witness, attorney, client or party. The role must sit inside a coherent proceeding structure and connect directly to the holder; a named third party is not the holder
a case-, claim-, docket-, reference- or account-number-shaped token. Its digits do not become a year, its prefix does not prove a court, and no Legal field exists to store it

the words legal, case, claim, complaint, dispute, demand, notice, hearing, appeal, order, judgment, settlement, release, signed, executed, notarized, confidential, privileged or without prejudice in a filename, subject line or isolated body passage

a signature line, notary seal, jurat phrase, apostille, witness block, court stamp, barcode, watermark or statement-of-truth clause. Blank templates, school permissions, ordinary agreements and identity records share those observations

an amount, address, deadline, hearing date, filing date, statutory citation, regulation, clause number, allegation or remedy. These can occur in tax, insurance, housing, school, licensing and ordinary administrative records and none is a Legal fact on this field-less schema

a source type or extension: text_document, ocr, image, spreadsheet, email, calendar, archive or opaque_binary; .pdf, .docx, .eml, .ics, .xlsx, .png or .zip. File kind is a routing clue and is constitutionally never sufficient

a folder named Legal, Court, Case, Lawyer, Important or Evidence, a scanning or download session, or several files sharing one party name. Existing curated structure may retrieve a bounded neighborhood, but grouping and path context do not write facts or prove template membership by themselves

semantic similarity, a neighboring group's matter label, or another file's caption. The graph assembles context rather than propagating a case reference, party, outcome, date or document kind onto this file
missing EXIF, a missing or broken text layer, OCR density, scanner metadata or a screenshot-style filename. Those observations decide an extraction path or capture hypothesis, not legal content

a portal badge, search-result snippet or screenshot reading filed, granted, dismissed, paid, closed or served. It is a saved observation at one time, not proof of the matter's current status or legal effect
a public court record's availability or a filing's apparent redaction. Publicly accessible does not mean non-sensitive, complete or appropriate for a cloud dossier
an unreadable, encrypted, damaged or unsupported file's filename. It remains metadata-only and routes to controlled review; the system does not infer a personal matter from the name

work_types: summons, writ, service or acknowledgment record
filing receipt, docket notice or electronic filing notice
hearing, conference, mediation or trial notice
enforcement, lien or collection proceeding record
family, custody or guardianship proceeding record
grouping_reasons: one personally held dispute or proceeding across its initiating papers, responses, notices, correspondence, evidence, settlement and order. A supported group keeps direct anchors separate from context-supported members and copies no matter attribute onto either

one pre-action dispute that later becomes a filed proceeding, when explicit references and direct party-facing evidence bridge the demand, response and filed papers. Similar subject matter or the same opponent name is not enough
one proceeding across native filings, filing-receipt emails, hearing calendar records and portal screenshots. Each file keeps only its own observations; the group label is not a fact
one evidence bundle whose index or manifest is the anchor and whose member files remain individually reviewable. Archive contents are inspected as a manifest and are not unpacked to disk
one filing or statement across drafts, corrected copies and served or stamped versions through the universal version_family and duplicate_family facts, not through a Legal-only status field

one personal matter that overlaps an accepted tax, insurance, association, school, credential, immigration, medical or identity group. Multi-membership is allowed at the group/schema level; the collision edge only prevents one shared observation from doing two jobs
one rare protected legal document by itself. The design explicitly permits legal documents to surface as protected records without meeting a normal group-size threshold
NOT a grouping reason: a shared law firm, court, party, statute, amount, date, folder name, download session or embedding neighborhood with no independently identified matter anchor

template.why: Empty by contract and by safety. This template uses the D1-deferred, field-less Legal schema, so no destination-eligible key exists and no matter, party, court, case number, status, outcome, deadline, jurisdiction or document kind may be smuggled in as a branch dimension. Safety activation unlocks protection rather than a deep filing tree, and a matter- or party-named branch could itself disclose protected information. The row remains useful because its holder-facing matter recognition, sibling boundaries and privacy rules differ from the broad Legal schema. It is not time-first: dates are evidence inside a matter, not an automatic folder axis. A user may later attach an accepted matter group to a user-approved protected node; this row recommends no automatic depth.

collides_with.signal: Home-instruction filings and personal legal proceedings can name the same child, school year, education authority, statute, deadline and parent. A completed education-authority notice or home-instruction compliance form is the Homeschool situation; a court or tribunal caption, adversarial party roles, service or hearing structure, and direct holder relation make the personal-matter situation. A statute, parent signature, official addressee or attorney letterhead alone decides neither. This reciprocates the landed neighbor.

Custody orders, guardianship affidavits, records-release authorizations and truancy papers can name the same child, school and year as ordinary K-12 records. Enrolled-student, school-issued record structure makes K-12; a proceeding caption, party roles, operative order or populated sworn block tied to the holder makes the personal legal matter. School letterhead, a child name, seal, citation or date alone decides neither. This reciprocates the landed neighbor.

Association enforcement and a contested legal matter share the association, member, address, rule citation, charge and deadline. An association-issued cure, architectural, hearing or board-review workflow without filed or adversarial matter structure is the HOA situation; a filed lien, contested collection, representative-to-holder demand, court or tribunal caption, settlement, appeal or operative order makes the personal legal matter. The allegation, amount, address and letterhead settle neither side. This reciprocates the landed neighbor.

A corporate liability claim and its legal dispute repeat the carrier, organization, claim reference, loss description and amount. A labelled policy, coverage, reserve, claim-register or loss-run structure reports on insurance; recitals identifying a dispute, adversarial correspondence, proceeding structure or an executed settlement resolving that dispute supports the personal legal matter. Carrier, claim reference, amount or reservation wording alone counts for neither. This reciprocates the landed neighbor.

A household liability claim and a personal legal matter share the people, loss event, claim reference and money figure. Carrier-issued claim, policy, estimate and coverage slots make Personal Insurance; a court caption, adversarial party roles, representative-to-holder matter letter or dispute-and-execution structure makes the personal legal matter. The claim number, person name and amount must not count twice. This reciprocates the landed neighbor.

A tax assessment, objection and tribunal dispute can repeat the authority, reference, tax year, amount and deadline. A labelled tax-year and assessment or return structure supports Tax Filings; a tribunal or case caption, adversarial roles, legal-representation block and contested-proceeding function support the personal legal matter. The authority, reference, amount and deadline decide neither side by themselves. This reciprocates the landed neighbor.

Birth, citizenship, naturalization and name-change records can establish identity or status and also record a legal act or order. A document whose own function is proving a bearer or civil status supports Core Identity; a proceeding caption, party roles, direct holder relation and operative order support the personal legal matter. One authority name, seal, person name or document number must not count twice. This reciprocates the landed neighbor.

Wills, trusts, powers of attorney, advance directives, probate papers and contested-estate filings share people, signatures, witnesses, notarial blocks and legal vocabulary. A planning or end-of-life instrument that creates or delegates future authority without an adversarial matter belongs to Estate Planning; a contest, claim, court caption, party roles, service, hearing or operative adjudicative order supports Personal Legal Matters. A notary block, named relative, executor term or court name alone decides neither.

An executed lease, agreement, amendment, release or settlement and a dispute file share parties, addresses, defined terms, numbered clauses and signatures. An instrument creating or recording an ongoing consensual obligation without dispute structure belongs to Leases and Agreements; a demand, filed claim, proceeding caption, contested party roles or settlement explicitly resolving an existing dispute supports Personal Legal Matters. Signature, governing-law language and party names alone decide neither.

A party's personal copy and a lawyer's professional file can contain byte-identical pleadings, orders, evidence and correspondence. Direct service or addressing to the holder, holder party/signature roles and absence of practice-only operations support Personal Legal Matters; a client-matter system export, firm matter identifier, conflicts/intake records, internal legal research or work product, time or client-ledger records, task plan and closing memorandum support the Practice Matter File. A standalone shared pleading with neither custody signal remains unresolved rather than being forced to either template.

falls_through_to.why: The primary fallthrough for an isolated court paper, sworn statement, representative letter, settlement or order whose deeper matter group is absent or unsafe to expose. Legal forms and documents are explicitly within the protected residual boundary, and protection does not require a large group.

For an unlabelled demand, ambiguous representative letter, sparse evidence index, custody-ambiguous pleading or mixed bundle whose legal reading is possible but whose personal-matter role is not resolved. Partial understanding remains reviewable rather than becoming a fabricated matter.

For password-protected archives, unreadable filings, damaged scans and unknown exports that cannot be inspected safely. The system retains metadata, does not infer purpose from the filename and may represent the file without moving it.

Only for a likely screenshot with no accepted matter group and OCR too weak or ambiguous to establish holder-facing legal content. A readable protected portal capture returns to normal Legal handling rather than being trapped as a generic screenshot.

For a published judgment, legal guide, case brief or public form saved for reading when no direct holder relation or active matter evidence exists. R2 may still over-protect a court-caption document; protected classification and personal template membership are separate decisions.

For a durable blank form, standalone official notice or reusable filing reference whose function is understood but which has no reliable personal matter, accepted group or deeper association. Sensitive content, if present, keeps Protected Records ahead of this broad option.

sensitivity_why: Personal matter files can expose names, home and service addresses, contact details, signatures, identifiers, financial circumstances, children, health information, allegations, witness material, settlement terms, representative communications and data about opponents or other third parties. 00 names legal records and private correspondence inside the highly personal corpus, requires privacy policy before any model or external connector, and says paths, complete text, OCR, user edits, group memberships and raw sensitive values remain local. This row assigns only potentially_sensitive; it does not assign, quote or recreate any P7 handling class. Protection precedes interpretation, raw filenames and contents are redacted in general summaries, and no cloud or automatic placement path is unlocked by activation.
open_question: Three product decisions remain open for this row. First, if D1's Legal deferral ever lifts, which canonical fields are legitimate - matter, proceeding role, instrument kind, counterparty and case reference are not present today, and this row neither reuses Finance fields nor proposes private replacements. Second, may a protected legal branch ever expose matter, party or document-kind labels in its path, or must the launch experience remain protected-flat and group-attached only? Third, when the same bytes appear in a party's own records and a practitioner's client file with no direct custody evidence, is user confirmation always required to select personal-matter versus practice-matter context? Until those decisions are ratified, fields, proposed_fields, dimension_order and role_split stay empty.
